description: This file defines the CommandScheduleRepository class, which manages database operations related to command schedules, including find, insert, delete, and update functionalities within a REST API service.

classes.name: CommandScheduleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing command schedule data in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: findByCommandId
methods.description: Retrieves command schedules associated with a specific command ID.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a command schedule by its unique ID, including creator's full name.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search for command schedules based on given criteria, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getBaseSelectQueryBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a base SQL select query builder for command schedules.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a command schedule record by its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new command schedule record into the database.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a command schedule record identified by its ID.
